title: French Language – Level 03
overview: French Language – Level 03 develops pre-intermediate communication skills for increasingly varied personal, social, travel, and workplace situations. Building on Level 02, participants strengthen control of past, present, and future forms, expand their vocabulary, and learn to connect ideas, express opinions, describe experiences, and manage everyday problems. The course integrates listening, speaking, reading, writing, pronunciation, and intercultural awareness through practical communicative tasks.
audience: Learners who have completed French Language – Level 02 or demonstrated equivalent elementary proficiency; students, working professionals, travelers, and individuals seeking greater independence and confidence in everyday French communication.
methodology: Communicative instructor-led workshops; scenario-based dialogues; paired and small-group speaking practice; authentic short audio and reading materials; guided grammar discovery; pronunciation coaching; structured writing tasks; vocabulary reviews; role plays; regular formative feedback; and integrated end-of-course assessments.
competencies: Sustained participation in familiar conversations and routine problem-solving exchanges.
More accurate use of past, present, and future constructions in connected speech.
Listening for main ideas and relevant details in clear everyday French.
Reading short narratives, instructions, notices, and practical workplace messages.
Writing connected paragraphs, emails, descriptions, and short accounts of events.
Expressing preferences, reasons, comparisons, suggestions, and simple opinions.
Improved pronunciation, interaction management, and intercultural appropriateness.
objectives: Describe experiences and events using the passé composé and introductory imparfait.
Explain future plans and intentions using the futur proche and futur simple.
Maintain conversations about work, leisure, travel, health, and daily responsibilities.
Express opinions, agreement, disagreement, preferences, and supporting reasons.
Ask for clarification, make suggestions, and resolve common service problems.
Understand key information in short interviews, announcements, and conversations.
Read and summarize accessible articles, messages, and narrative passages.
Write structured emails, short stories, descriptions, and practical requests.
Use common pronouns, connectors, comparisons, and polite forms with greater accuracy.
Demonstrate integrated language skills through realistic communication tasks.
